blocks.source: 英雄伝説 零の軌跡
blocks.translation: The Legend of Heroes: Trails from Zero

blocks.source: 質量／物語
blocks.translation: Content / Story

blocks.source: ２つの大国に挟まれる『クロスベル自治区』が舞台。クロスベル警察の『特務支援課』に配属された４人はクロスベル市を拠点として、様々な問題に対して立ち向かっていく。
blocks.translation: The game is set in Crossbell State, situated between two great powers. The four members assigned to the Crossbell Police Department's Special Support Section take Crossbell City as their base and confront a variety of problems.

blocks.source: 前作『空の奇跡』では『リベール王国』を舞台としていたが、今回はそれよりも舞台は狭い。といっても、量的に劣るわけではなく、恐らく、空の軌跡ＦＣ・ＳＣの合計に近い規模はあるかと思う。
blocks.translation: The previous game, Trails in the Sky, was set in the Liberl Kingdom, but this game's setting is more limited in scope. That said, it is not inferior in terms of quantity; it probably has a scale close to the combined size of Trails in the Sky FC and SC.

blocks.source: プレイ時間は攻略サイトを見ながら、依頼を全てこなすというスタイルで、クリアまで６０時間程度。攻略情報を見なければ、もっとかかるはず。
blocks.translation: With the play style of referring to a strategy site and completing all requests, it takes approximately 60 hours to finish. It should take longer if you do not look at a strategy guide.

blocks.source: 町人の会話はストーリーの進展に伴い細かく変化していく。主人公の幼馴染のパン職人といった顔グラなしのモブキャラですらしっかりと会話が作りこまれている。
blocks.translation: The townspeople's conversations change in detail as the story progresses. Even minor characters without face graphics, such as the protagonist's childhood friend who works as a baker, have thoroughly developed dialogue.

blocks.source: ストーリー上の特定期間でしか見れないサブイベントが非常に多く全てのイベントを見尽くそうと思うと、とても大変。
blocks.translation: There are so many side events that can only be seen during specific periods in the story that trying to see every event is extremely difficult.

blocks.source: メインメンバーの４人は今回から新規に登場するキャラクター。主人公のロイドを始め頭の良い登場人物が多く、会話内容に感心させられる。多数存在する登場人物を交差させながら、終着点に持っていくシナリオ運びは鮮やか。シナリオライターの頭が良くないことには、こんな風には中々書けないと思う。
blocks.translation: The four main members are all new characters introduced in this game. Starting with the protagonist Lloyd, many of the characters are intelligent, and their conversations are impressive. The scenario skillfully brings the story to its conclusion while interweaving its many characters. I don't think a scenario writer who wasn't intelligent could write something like this very easily.

blocks.source: 物語としては、空の軌跡ＦＣの様なすっきりしない終わり方ではないが、若干の謎を残したまま終わる。恐らく、続編の『碧の軌跡』にて、解決するものと思われるので期待したい。
blocks.translation: The story does not end as unsatisfactorily as Trails in the Sky FC, but it does conclude with a few mysteries left unresolved. They will presumably be resolved in the sequel, Trails to Azure, so I look forward to it.

blocks.source: 空の軌跡に登場したキャラクターも出番が多く、終盤には仲間になったりする。前作をプレイしていれば、ニヤリとできる会話が多い。というか、プレイしていないと理解できない会話が多くてモヤモヤするはず。よって、前作のプレイは前提条件かも。
blocks.translation: Characters who appeared in Trails in the Sky also have plenty of screen time, and some even join the party toward the end. There are many conversations that will make you grin if you played the previous game. In fact, there are so many conversations that you won't understand without having played it that you are bound to feel frustrated. Thus, playing the previous game may be a prerequisite.

blocks.source: システムとして、本筋とは別に町人からの依頼をこなすことができるが、内容は『魔獣を倒して材料を集めてきてくれ』等、お使い的なものが多い。本筋が良くできているだけに、どうしてもテンポが削がれるのが気になるところ。というか、本筋の中にもお使いっぽいイベントがかなり多い。時間を掛けてまったりとプレイするタイプのゲームなのだと思う。
blocks.translation: As part of the system, you can complete requests from townspeople separately from the main story, but many are fetch quests such as “Defeat the monsters and collect some materials for me.” Since the main story is so well made, it is especially noticeable when these quests disrupt the pacing. In fact, there are also quite a few fetch-quest-like events within the main story. I think this is the type of game meant to be played leisurely over a long period of time.

blocks.source: 収集要素も多く存在する。全巻集めると最強武器の素材が貰える書物が存在するが、入手条件は期間が非常に限られている物が多く非常にシビア。その他にも、途中で見逃すと手に入らなくなるアイテムなどが多く存在する。コンプしたければ、攻略情報は必須。
blocks.translation: There are also many collection elements. One book rewards you with materials for the strongest weapon when you collect all its volumes, but the acquisition windows are extremely limited for many of them, making this very demanding. There are also many items that become unobtainable if you miss them along the way. Walkthrough information is essential if you want to complete everything.

blocks.source: システム／バランス／快適性
blocks.translation: Systems / Balance / Comfort

blocks.source: 強化システムのオーブメントは前作から大きな変更はなく、相変わらずの複雑ぶり。ただし、手に入るクオーツ（マテリアっぽいもの）や覚えられるアーツ（魔法に相当）の種類や効果は調整されており、万能キャラは作りにくくなった。それにより、どのクオーツを装備するか悩む楽しさは増えた。
blocks.translation: The Orbment enhancement system has not changed significantly from the previous game and remains as complicated as ever. However, the types and effects of the obtainable Quartz (something like Materia) and learnable Arts (equivalent to magic) have been adjusted, making it harder to create an all-purpose character. This makes deciding which Quartz to equip more enjoyable.

blocks.source: また、前作と違って上級のアーツはきちんと威力が上がるため使用機会は多い。反面、物理攻撃は頼りない印象。特に今回のクラフト（特技に相当）は威力が高い物が少ないため、余計にそう感じる。
blocks.translation: Unlike in the previous game, advanced Arts properly increase in power, so they see plenty of use. Physical attacks, on the other hand, feel unreliable. This is especially noticeable because few of the Crafts (equivalent to Techs) in this game have high power.

blocks.source: 戦闘難易度はノーマルでプレイしたが、かなり簡単。味方が覚えるアーツやクラフトの中には、強力な物が多数存在する。序盤から使用できる複数回復クラフトは非常に便利なので、そうそう全滅することはない。
blocks.translation: I played on Normal difficulty, and it was quite easy. Among the Arts and Crafts learned by allies are many powerful options. Since the multi-target healing Craft available from the early stages is extremely useful, it is unlikely that your party will be wiped out.

blocks.source: 手応えがないという人のために、ゲーム開始時に難易度設定をすることもできる。ただし、あまり戦闘テンポが良くないゲームなので、難易度を上げると、余計に戦闘が長引いて辛いかもしれない。
blocks.translation: For those who want more of a challenge, you can set the difficulty when starting the game. However, the battle pacing is not particularly good, so raising the difficulty may make battles drag on even longer and become painful.

blocks.source: 当作品はシンボルエンカウント形式だが、今回から『フィールドアクション』が追加されて、敵シンボルに対して、攻撃できるようになった。これにより、敵シンボルの動きを止めて避けたり、背後から攻撃してピヨらせることができるようになった。特にピヨらせた状態で戦闘に突入すると、先手が取れるので非常に有利。ただし、楽ではあるが一方的にボコるだけなので、ザコ戦が単調になりやすい。
blocks.translation: This game uses symbol encounters, but a Field Action has been added this time, allowing you to attack enemy symbols. This lets you stop enemy symbols in their tracks and evade them, or attack from behind to stun them. Entering battle while they are stunned is especially advantageous because you can take the initiative. However, although it makes things easy, you are merely beating enemies up one-sidedly, so battles with weak enemies can easily become monotonous.

blocks.source: 戦闘テンポは前作とあまり変わらずゆったり。『移動』『戦闘アニメ』『ダメージ表示』といったそれぞれの動作は遅め。敵のＨＰも高めなので、ザコ戦でも数分掛かることはざら。
blocks.translation: The battle pacing remains leisurely, much like in the previous game. Actions such as “movement,” “battle animations,” and “damage display” are all rather slow. Since enemies also have fairly high HP, it is common for even battles with weak enemies to take several minutes.

blocks.source: メインイベント・依頼共に強制戦闘が多いのも相変わらず。依頼の中には「ダンジョン内の雑魚敵を全滅させる」「一度クリアしたダンジョンの奥で手配魔獣を倒す」等の達成条件が面倒な物も多い。
blocks.translation: As usual, there are many forced battles in both main events and requests. Many requests also have troublesome completion conditions, such as “defeat all the weak enemies in a dungeon” or “defeat a wanted monster deep inside a dungeon you have already cleared.”

blocks.source: 移動に関して、クロスベル市内では、スタートボタンによるショートカットが可能。市外の施設についても、バス移動で省略できるといった配慮がされている。
blocks.translation: As for movement, you can use a shortcut with the Start button within Crossbell City. Consideration has also been given to facilities outside the city, which can be reached by bus to skip the journey.

blocks.source: 美術
blocks.translation: Visuals

blocks.source: キャラクターデザインは前作から一新。前作キャラクターのイラストも描き直しされているが、歩行時のキャラクターグラフィックは前作の流用だったりする。全体的に当作品より、６年前に発売された空の軌跡ＦＣと比較して、さほど代わり映えはないけれど、街やダンジョンの造形など、地味に綺麗になっている。
blocks.translation: The character designs were completely revamped from the previous game. Although the illustrations of returning characters were also redrawn, the character graphics used while walking are sometimes reused from the previous game. Overall, compared with Trails in the Sky FC, released six years before this game, it is not dramatically different, but the towns and dungeons have quietly become more beautiful.

blocks.source: ＦＦの様な派手なムービーシーンはないものの、イベントシーンでキャラクターはピョンピョンと良く動く。でも、時々「××はおじぎした」「××は○○の頭をなでた」という様に動作を文章で表現して済ませる手抜きっぽい部分も。
blocks.translation: Although there are no flashy movie scenes like those in FF, the characters move around energetically during event scenes. However, there are also occasionally somewhat lazy-looking parts where actions are conveyed through text, such as “×× bowed” or “×× patted ○○ on the head.”

blocks.source: 音楽
blocks.translation: Music

blocks.source: これについては、安心のファルコムブランド。空の軌跡より若干インパクトで劣るかもしれないが、戦闘曲、ダンジョン曲、イベント曲など良曲が揃っている。
blocks.translation: This is where the Falcom brand delivers with confidence. It may have slightly less impact than Trails in the Sky, but it is filled with excellent music, including battle, dungeon, and event themes.
